fix: hold every edge; when resolving, an edge that lies on a cycle and is the greatest by (asserted_at, attestation_id) on it confers nothing. Or simpler and order-free: no edge on a cycle confers anything
by_signed_instant_then_id: of the edges on a cycle the one with the greatest (asserted_at, attestation_id) is the closing edge and confers nothing
rank_note: both are functions of the set. 'No edge on a cycle confers' cannot be gamed by dating; the ranked form lets the later signer lose, which the earlier delegator may prefer
cell: CC 4.1.1 table: 'Substrate MUST detect cycles on the delegates_to graph and reject the cycle-closing emission'. No guard cell types it (fm.freshness trust note: 'charter/cycle read received_at')
causal_link_today: each edge names delegator and delegate; nothing more is needed
symmetric_outcome: every edge is kept. Standing is the least fixed point from the root: authority only attenuates along an edge, so an edge back to an ancestor confers nothing new and a cycle is harmless. No edge is refused or voided
cost: none. (Voiding every edge on a cycle would be worse: a delegate could cut off the chain above it by delegating back.)
